judgment.rationale: Both are Knowledge Objectives at the same grain and same resolved coordinate (P3, rank 2) within Unit 3 'Numbers from 0 to 10000'. The first requires identifying the place value of each digit in a four-digit number; the second requires illustrating multiplication of a 3-digit by a 2-digit number with products bounded at 10,000. Multi-digit multiplication within that bound depends on decomposing numbers by place value (tens/hundreds/thousands partial products and regrouping), so secure place-value knowledge of four-digit numbers substantively supports success on the multiplication objective; the reverse dependency is not supported. Same-rank direction is justified by this specific conceptual support, not by shared parent, shared Unit, or lexical overlap (shared tokens were generic: 'a', 'digit', 'of', 'the').
